what: TCPMT round 3 --- tier order of a converter cell with MIXED tiers.
rule: production order = the order of the decided tiers with the best heat path among the orders meeting the via rule (AR <= 1 on every via level, die terminals on both faces); if none meets it, the order with the best worst-via aspect ratio, ties broken by the heat path
